mostWorthwhile.text: Correcting the transcript was most worthwhile: it changed the job from software to cooling while preserving the audio for checking, and ultimately led to the right cartridge.

leastWorthwhile.text: The repeated ordering guesses were less satisfying: the model photograph was rejected twice before it became usable, although the automatic combinations kept progress moving.

surprise.text: Moth turned train noise into a confident but wrong computer-repair request; the plausible wording made the error particularly striking.

arbitrary.text: The required order for linking the sourced request to Moth before using the model photograph was not clear to me from the available pieces.

continue.text: Yes, I would continue: the concrete sign repair and the way a human correction affected the clinic repair made me curious about what happens next, despite the occasionally opaque ordering.
